What we collect. When you submit a form on this site (booking a consultation, sending an enquiry, or subscribing to our newsletter), we collect the details you provide — such as your name, school name, email, phone number, and message.

How we use it. We use this information only to respond to your enquiry, schedule consultations, and — if you subscribe — send occasional newsletter updates. We do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing purposes.

Cookies. This site uses cookies to remember your preferences (such as whether you've seen our welcome screen or accepted this cookie notice). We do not use cookies for third-party advertising.

Third-party services. Form submissions are processed via FormSubmit; WhatsApp conversations are handled directly through WhatsApp's own platform, subject to WhatsApp's privacy terms.

WHO WE ARE

Your partner in building a smarter, stronger school.

TeachSphere is a forward-thinking Education Technology and School Growth Company dedicated to transforming the way schools teach, manage, and grow. We provide innovative digital solutions, strategic marketing services, professional training, and educational consulting that empower schools to achieve excellence in teaching, learning, administration, and enrolment.

We believe every school deserves access to modern technology, effective management systems, and sustainable growth strategies — bridging the gap between traditional education and the digital future.

OUR STORY

TeachSphere was born out of a passion for education and a desire to solve the everyday challenges schools face daily — declining admissions, limited digital presence, inefficient administration, and inadequate access to modern technology.

Recognizing this gap, we set out to provide practical, innovative, and affordable solutions that help institutions thrive — evolving into a comprehensive education solutions company that helps schools build stronger brands, attract more learners, streamline operations, and prepare students for the future.

"When schools grow, communities flourish, and futures are transformed."

MEET THE FOUNDER
Adebowale Adeleye
Founder & Chief Executive Officer

Adebowale Adeleye is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of TeachSphere, an Education Technology and School Growth Company committed to helping schools embrace digital transformation. With a hands-on, results-driven approach, he works directly with school owners and administrators to design practical technology, marketing, and training solutions that strengthen operations, improve visibility, and drive sustainable enrolment growth. His vision is to build TeachSphere into a trusted, long-term partner for schools across Nigeria and Africa.

QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you develop school portals?

Yes. We implement and support trusted school management platforms — such as our partner Edusmartech — configured and set up for your school's specific needs. TeachSphere is not the owner of the underlying platform; we handle implementation, training, and ongoing support.

Do you design school websites?

Yes. We design and build custom school websites tailored to your institution's brand, structure, and communication needs.

Do you train teachers?

Yes. We provide professional development programmes for teachers, school leaders, and administrators to build capacity alongside any technology we implement.

Can TeachSphere help increase school enrolment?

Yes. Through strategic digital marketing, admission campaign management, and lead generation, we help schools reach more qualified families and convert enquiries into enrolments.

Do you provide educational consulting beyond technology?

Yes. Our consulting covers strategy, operations, and growth planning — not just digital tools — so improvements are sustainable long-term.

What happens during the consultation process?

We start with a free discovery consultation to understand your school's goals, followed by an assessment and a tailored strategy before any implementation begins.
